relations.subject: Benimadhab Barua
relations.evidence: Barua joined the Mahāmuni Anglo-Pāli Institution as headmaster in 1912.

relations.subject: Benimadhab Barua
relations.evidence: From 1913 to 1914 he worked as a lecturer in the Pāli department of the University of Calcutta.

relations.subject: Benimadhab Barua
relations.evidence: He earned an MA in Greek and Modern European Philosophy from the University of London.

relations.subject: Benimadhab Barua
relations.evidence: In 1917 he was awarded a D.Litt. by the University of London.

relations.subject: Benimadhab Barua
relations.evidence: After returning to India in 1918, Barua rejoined Calcutta University and was promoted to a professorship.

relations.subject: A. L. Basham
relations.evidence: Barua's 1921 work on The Ajivikas served as the background for "History and Doctrines of the Ajivikas" (1950) the PhD dissertation of  A. L. Basham, who cites Barua's work frequently.
